title: Jehu Destroys Ahab's House
description: Jehu sends letters to Samaria demanding that Ahab's seventy sons be executed. After their heads are brought to Jizreel, he kills the rest of Ahab's house there, as well as Ahaziah's brothers at Beth-Eked. Together with Jonadab son of Rekab, he goes to Samaria and wipes out the last of Ahab's family, just as the Lord had spoken through Elijah.
